youtube_title: Posey Chapel Cemetery near LaPorte: the chapel that burned in 1972
body: On a hill northeast of LaPorte, near Hesston, is Posey Chapel Cemetery. In 1841, settlers built a log chapel here, named for circuit preacher Wade Posey; local history says it was Galena Township's first church. A new chapel replaced it in 1855 and stood for more than a century, until arsonists burned it to the ground on the night of January 26, 1972. A pavilion stands near the spot today. Visitors report glowing lights among the stones and sounds they can't explain. It's a real cemetery: please visit in daylight and be respectful. 🕯️ Comment your town, and it could be next! #LaPorte #LaPorteCounty #Hesston #Indiana #History #LaPorteAfterDark
